# LootTriage

A lightweight addon for when your bags are full and you're looting. It has no extra windows, it just shows you what's worth taking and what to delete.

When you loot with full bags, LootTriage does two things:
* Loot that's worth more than your junk gets a little gold coin on it in the loot window
* The items you should delete to make room get a gold border in your bags, numbered so you know which one goes first

* <https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/loot-triage>
